title: 2008 Noida double murder (Aarushi-Hemraj)
narrative: FIR — night of 15-16 May 2008, L-32 Jalvayu Vihar, Sector 25, Noida. Aarushi Talwar, aged 13, and the domestic help Hemraj Banjade, aged 45, were found murdered with their throats slit by a sharp weapon and blunt-force head injuries. The parents, Dr. Rajesh Talwar and Dr. Nupur Talwar, were the accused. The post-mortem noted clinically precise neck incisions. Evidence included a blood-stained whisky bottle bearing both victims' DNA and drag marks on the terrace. The Uttar Pradesh Police investigated first; the Central Bureau of Investigation took over on 31 May 2008. The trial court convicted the Talwars in 2013; the Allahabad High Court acquitted them in 2017.
